rashtriya-panchang-1948-online.method: Transcribed by app.modules.calendar.transcribe_rp from the saved pages; tithi ending moments are IST and geocentric (valid for every place, per the edition's Explanation); sunrise is the upper limb with 31' refraction, to the minute, for the four metropolitan cities. No value was computed by the engine under test.

divergences.source_says: margashirsha (printed '(Margasirsa Krishna) Amavasya h. 30-22' on 8 December 2026, page 'agrahayana')
divergences.evidence: The same table prints the preceding tithi as '(Kartika Krishna) Chaturdasi h. 28-13' and the next as '(Margasirsa Sukla) Pratipad'; the edition's Explanation reckons lunar months from the day after the new moon (amanta); the other 11 Amavasyas of the edition carry the month of their preceding Chaturdasi. The engine names this Amavasya kartika.
